description: This file defines the VoiceWakeForwarder enum, which provides static methods for voice wake forwarding functionalities including message preprocessing, error handling, and communication with a gateway service.

classes.name: VoiceWakeForwardError
classes.description: An error type representing failures in the voice wake forwarding process, conforming to LocalizedError and Equatable.

methods.name: prefixedTranscript
methods.description: Prepares a transcript message with machine name context for voice wake forwarding.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Sends a voice transcript message to a gateway, with options, and returns success or failure.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks the connectivity/status of the gateway connection.
